name: Warren Brown
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Warren Brown (born 11 May 1978) is an English actor and former professional Thaiboxer, well known for his roles as Andy Holt in teen soap opera Hollyoaks and Lee Hibbs in the three-part BBC drama series Occupation written by Peter Bowker. Brown was born in Warrington, Cheshire, England. Description above from the Wikipedia article Warren Brown (actor), licensed under CC-BY-SA, full list of contributors on Wikipedia.
